The day at a glance

Starts in the Paso Robles AVA, one of California's largest, where hot days and cool nights suit cabernet and the rhône varieties; the vineyards run right up to the edge of town. Crossing the range on Highway 41 the planting stops abruptly, and the coastal side is vegetable ground and pasture around Los Osos and Oceano.

Worth looking up for

  • Crosses the coast range on Highway 41 and drops to Morro Bay, then runs south past Los Osos.
  • Templeton and Los Osos are both on the route; Morro Rock is the landmark at the coast.

What to watch for

  • The Highway 41 climb is mi 17.6–19.0, 388 ft at 5.4% — steady rather than steep.
  • Highway 41 over the grade is a main road between US-101 and Highway 1, so expect through traffic. Nobody has checked the shoulder — worth asking someone who has ridden it.
